Headline: Closure - King Solomon High School (State), London
Info: King Solomon High School is currently consulting on a potential closure at the end of the academic year due to falling pupil numbers, prompting some students to transfer early to Yavneh College.

Headline: Merger - Chiltern Learning Trust and IFTL (State), Bedfordshire and Milton Keynes
Info: Chiltern Learning Trust and Inspiring Futures through Learning (IFTL) are preparing to merge into a new 43-school academy trust, prompting Chiltern CEO Adrian Rogers to announce his departure at the end of the current academic year.

Headline: Closure - Burnhaven School (State), Aberdeenshire
Info: Aberdeenshire Council is launching a consultation that could result in the permanent closure of Burnhaven School in Peterhead, as the state primary's roll has fallen to just 11 pupils.
